artworks.name: 寒霜之祠
artworks.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit Image 1, the second-version Frost Shrine, into a more abstract crafted trophy BUILDING. Image 2 is our first version, included ONLY to remind you of its architectural vessel/alcove structure. Preserve Image 1's successful muted grey, off-white and blue-ice palette, rough Don't Starve Together 2D ink-and-gouache drawing, and the small offering core inside a dark alcove. Preserve true transparent background.
User art direction: Version 2 is very good but too literally a portrait of Frostjaw. Keep characteristic harvested materials and design motifs, but REMOVE the boss's actual face and anatomy. The goal is a distinct crafted shrine whose ingredients recall Frostjaw, like a Scaled Furnace recalls its boss. Do not simply erase eyes while leaving an obvious animal head. Redesign the facade into unmistakable masonry architecture.
Specific changes:
- Remove BOTH eyes/eye slits, eyebrow ridge, broad shark muzzle, forehead X scars, flanking grey horn/ear shapes, every bone-white mouth tooth, and all hands/claws/limbs. There must be no recognizable face, head or living-creature expression.
- Replace the upper/front face with a compact squat domed and slightly tapered stone vessel/shrine, clearly built from 3-5 large irregular ash-grey fitted stone panels. Visible dark seams and a simple thick polygonal lintel frame an open vertical oval/rounded trapezoid offering niche. Calm architectural geometry, no scales or facial arrangement. Moderate three-quarter view with visible top/side planes.
- Keep ONE swept blue ice fin as an architectural roof crest. Make it approximately half the height of the giant blade in version 2, placed slightly behind the roof apex, not on a forehead. A modest bold angled top ornament, not a horned head.
- Reuse Frostjaw's distinctive blue-grey white-edged crystalline ice-jaw MATERIAL as a low segmented decorative apron around the lower outer body: just 3-5 short broad upward ice blades set into the plinth, separated by visible stone. The blades must remain below the mid-height of the offering opening; no continuous tall U-shaped jaw and no long chin point. Recognizable motif without reproducing the animal mouth.
- Reduce the off-white shaggy mane drastically into a narrow fur trim tucked under the upper roof rim, with two short irregular hanging strips toward the sides. Rough white tufts remain identifiable but occupy only about 10-15% of the object. The front and most of the shell remain exposed stone. Do not ring the whole front like a face or lion mane.
- Replace the clawed side feet with plain squat stone buttresses merging into a low chipped oval masonry footing, no finger shapes. Base modest, no scene floor.
- Keep the luminous icy offering core inside the niche, a small irregular crystal on a low bowl, clearly readable at 128px, only restrained pale cyan light. No literal heart emblem necessary.
Composition: exactly one complete centered structure on square transparent canvas with comfortable 10% margins, broad and squat around 1.15x taller than wide. Match native Don't Starve in-world camera, slightly overhead three-quarter; preserve handmade crooked contours and two or three flat shadow values. Bold dark outer ink, sparse fine pen hatching, desaturated palette, restrained surface grain. Practical sprite preview, not an ornate concept painting.
Critical rejection: no eyes, eye-like holes, brow, face, teeth, nose, forehead scars, paws, claws, arm/leg anatomy, bilateral horns, head silhouette, animal-shaped opening. Do not turn it into a generic ice castle. Preserve recognizably Frostjaw-derived ice fin, white fur trim and ice-blade apron, integrated into the architecture. No text, frame, extra objects, background, external shadow, checkerboard, photorealism, 3D render, smooth airbrush or big glow.

artworks.name: 霜冻核心
artworks.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Refine Image 1, the approved-direction second-version Frost Core inventory sprite. The user wants representative Frostjaw material cues, but a less literal anatomical resemblance. Preserve the overall icy nucleus, swept icy top, dark ink drawing, muted blue-grey/offwhite palette, three-quarter inventory view, and transparent background. Make a restrained targeted simplification, not a completely unrelated object.
Changes:
1. Remove the TWO upright grey horn/tooth-shaped pieces at the upper left and right. Remove the pointed grey jawbone outline and continuous face/mouth-like lower frame.
2. Simplify the large symmetrical ice-jaw fan into THREE separate chunky ice-shell fragments cupping the lower half of the central nucleus: a low broad front fragment, a shorter one to one side, a slightly taller hooked fragment to the other. They retain Frostjaw's distinctive blue-grey planes and sharp chalk-white facet edges. Reduce these framing pieces in height so the nucleus dominates (roughly 65% of visible area), and make their placement slightly asymmetric, so they read as broken magical ice shell, not a jaw, beard, crown or animal mask.
3. Keep a tiny scrap of offwhite shaggy material tucked BEHIND the bottom edge as a subtle source-material hint, approximately 5-8% of total silhouette, not a large wreath of fur.
4. Keep the nucleus's one swept fin-like peak but shorten it a little, balancing a compact portable item silhouette. Preserve the angular pale-white light/fracture inside the nucleus; no heart pictogram.
Style: Don't Starve Together 2D inventory item, bold uneven charcoal outlines, flat restrained gouache areas, 2-3 sharp value steps, short scratchy hatching, limited large facets. Clear at 64px. Do not over-detail.
Exactly one centered complete compact loose item, not a shrine or a character, full view on genuinely transparent background with 12% margins. No face, eyes, symmetrical horns, identifiable jawbone or teeth, no limbs, no plinth or metal apparatus, no photorealism, 3D shading, auras, particles, text or borders.
